page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.16xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core processing capabilities. The instance achieves top-tier results in multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Large-block read-only memory bandwidth and PassMark database operations also rank in the top 25% of tested configurations. Conversely, single-core metrics, such as Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core performance, fall within the average range. Large-model LLM text generation represents a relative bottleneck, with text generation for a small 135M model scoring in the bottom 25%.

Given its high vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 1:2 and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. It is suited for multi-threaded batch processing, database operations, and compilation tasks. However, workloads requiring high-capacity local storage, GPU acceleration, or large-scale LLM text generation are better served by other hardware profiles.
